tagline.en: Personal location tracking through a phone app, with its own MQTT broker and a position history
tagline.pt: Rastreamento de localização pessoal via app de celular, com broker MQTT próprio e histórico de posições

owntracks-mosquitto-passwd.value: manual generate it with `mosquitto_passwd -c -b <file> owntracks <the-same-password>` (see the README)
owntracks-mosquitto-passwd.note: A Mosquitto password file, not a loose value: it has to be produced by mosquitto_passwd with the SAME password as owntracks-mqtt-password.

mosquitto.conf.note: Read by the app, never written by it: the destination is inside a volume, so it cannot be derived from the unit the way an .env can. Same as above: without it the broker accepts no connection from the other containers.

frontend-config.js.note: Where the frontend looks for the recorder's API.
